fields.product: lithium carbonate, lithium hydroxide, lithium chloride, lithium metal

rows.notes: SMM (2023-03-31, FY2022 report) gives Shehong: 14,500 t Li2CO3 + 5,000 t LiOH + 4,500 t LiCl + 200 t Li metal. capacity_norm = 14,500 + 5,000x0.880 (monohydrate, D-102) + 4,500x0.871 + 200x5.323 = 23,885 t LCE (units.csv factors; my arithmetic). The same article's per-site figures (Shehong 24,200 product-t + Zhangjiagang 20,000 + Tongliang 600 + Kwinana 24,000 + Anju 20,000) sum to the 88,800 t/yr group total in S8 (2024-03-01), so Shehong figures were still current in early 2024. FY2024 group total rose to 91,600 t (S7): +2,800 t not allocated to a site in any source found. FY2025 report gives only the group total >120,000 t (S5) - no per-site table could be read. Tianqi website says first lithium carbonate plant built at Shehong in 1992 (tool summary, not verbatim; start_year left null). Coordinates = Shehong county town (named locality).

SMM 2023 (FY2022): Zhangjiagang 20,000 t battery-grade lithium carbonate. Tianqi website lists a separate Zhangjiagang-area plant described as 'fully automated battery-grade lithium carbonate plant' (S9; the second plant, the new hydroxide line, is listed under Suzhou) - see tianqi-lithium-zhangjiagang-hydroxide-china; two distinct plants, one row each. Not checked against FY2025 report (no per-site table readable); the carbonate line may have been switched or flexed since. Coordinates = Zhangjiagang city centroid (named locality). Feedstock not stated in sources.

fields.product: battery-grade lithium hydroxide (flexible to lithium carbonate)

rows.notes: FY2025 annual report: 30,000 t/yr lithium hydroxide project at Zhangjiagang 'successfully completed', ramping up; can flex between hydroxide and carbonate. Wallstreetcn/Longbridge (2026-03-27): joint trial run from 2025-07-30, first battery-grade product 2025-10-17, 'not yet reached full production capacity' (S10). Status set operational (production started, ramping) - installed (producing) capacity not disclosed, left null. capacity_ref_year 2025 = completion year. The group's 91,600 t (2024) -> >120,000 t (2025) step (S7, S5) is consistent with this +30,000 t. Does not use the 20kt Zhangjiagang carbonate plant's capacity (separate row).

SMM (2023-12-27): Anju 20,000 t Li2CO3, trial run from 2023-10-26, first battery-grade product confirmed 2023-12-21; article also says capacity will rise to 54,500 t as the Suining Anju base ramps up and mentions a 1bn-yuan phase 2 with a '23,000-mt lithium chloride line' - the 54,500 t figure is ambiguous (not clearly Anju-only or carbonate) so NOT used as capacity. Included in group total 88,800 t (S8, 2024-03-01), so counted as built then. Ramp-up status after 2024 not confirmed. Coordinates = Anju district, Suining (named locality), approximate.

Existing plant 600 t Li metal (SMM FY2022, S2). FY2025 report: 'lithium metal expansion project in Tongliang, Chongqing progressed steadily' (S6, under construction at end-2025); 10jqka (2026-03-28) names the '重庆1000吨/年金属锂项目' (S11). capacity 1,600 = 600 existing + 1,000 expansion (my sum; the Tianqi website timeline, read via tool summary and not quoted, also says 1,600 t after the expansion and dates its completion to Nov 2026 - NOT confirmed verbatim, so the expansion is not counted as installed). capacity_ref_year 2026 = publication-year fallback (completion date unconfirmed). Coordinates = Tongliang district centre (named locality), approximate.

fields.product: lithium hydroxide, lithium carbonate (and lithium chloride)

rows.notes: Ganfeng FY2025 annual report (via Wallstreetcn): '万吨锂盐厂' LiOH 81,000 t/yr + Li2CO3 15,000 t/yr 'at end of reporting period' (S12). capacity_norm = 81,000x0.880 + 15,000 = 86,280 t LCE (units.csv monohydrate factor, D-102; my arithmetic). Identification of '万吨锂盐厂' with the Xinyu Mahong plant is INFERRED: the Dec-2021 Ganfeng release (BatteriesNews, S17) says Mahong (Xinyu High-tech zone, founded 2012) total designed LiOH capacity would reach 81,000 t - same number; the same release says Mahong can also produce 12,000 t LiCl (not added). Hydroxide steps from S17 (not in capacity_by_year_json because units are product-t not LCE): 11,000 t (2016), +20,000 (2018), +50,000 (commissioned late 2020). Battery-grade LiOH start 2014 per S17. 81,000 t LiOH and 15,000 t Li2CO3 are flexible/design figures, so the sum overstates simultaneous output. Coordinates = Xinyu city centroid (named locality). Also Xinyu Ganfeng (LiF/Li metal/butyllithium, other site) capacity not found.
FY2025 annual report 'existing lithium salt capacity': 宁都赣锋 Li2CO3 20,000 t/yr (S12). Feedstock and start year not found. Coordinates = Ningdu county town (named locality), approximate.

FY2025 report: Sichuan Ganfeng Li2CO3 25,000 t/yr + LiOH 25,000 t/yr (S12). capacity_norm = 25,000 + 25,000x0.880 = 47,000 t LCE (my arithmetic; the company calls it a '5万吨锂盐项目', i.e. 50,000 t product-tonnes). FY2024 report (S14): built and put into operation end-2024, commissioning, capacity to be released through 2025; 2026-04-01 press (S15): line commissioning completed in H1 2025, carbonate capacity running at full load (hydroxide state not stated). Installed/producing capacity not quantified -> null. Exact site not found in any opened source (an executive was reported in 2025 mentioning Dazhou/Inner Mongolia lithium-salt projects coming on stream - whether Sichuan Ganfeng = Dazhou not established) -> no coordinates.

fields.asset_name: Suining Shengxin Technology lithium salt project (Sichuan)

rows.notes: Page summary of the broker report: 10,000 t/yr design, '目前已建成投产5000吨' (5,000 t built and in production). Only the 5,000 t quote is verbatim; the 10,000 t design figure comes from the page summary and is not separately quoted (unverified verbatim). The tool summary described this as a salt-lake lithium project - the feedstock/product type is therefore uncertain (possible overlap with off-salar vs on-site boundary; check). Sum of Shengxin built China salt: 42,000 + 30,000 + 5,000 = 77,000 t, matching the report's '7.7万吨 in China' total.

Broker report page: 3,000 t/yr lithium metal design, '目前已建成产能500吨' (500 t built). Only the 500 t quote is verbatim; 3,000 t design from page summary. Status operational is an inference from 'built capacity 500 t'; whether it is producing is not stated.
